technical_notes.session_issue_details: After successful quick login (e.g., pm@sipro.co.id as Proyek), the session cookie is not being maintained when Playwright navigates to other pages. The app redirects back to /login. This suggests either: (1) Cookie domain/path mismatch, (2) SameSite cookie attribute issue, (3) Session not being written to cookie properly, or (4) Playwright context not preserving cookies across navigations.
